title: The stationary Wick-dominant non-Gaussian class has the profiled Gaussian coefficient and rigid minimizers

coefficient_theorem.finite_cutoff_identity: The infimum over T_N^+ equals the exact stationary diagonal Gaussian infimum at every cutoff because K1576 gives the lower reduction and Gaussian states supply equality.
coefficient_theorem.coefficient_limit: K1572 therefore implies inf_(psi in T_N^+) E_N[psi]/N^4 -> h_g^prof for every fixed positive coupling g.
coefficient_theorem.coupling_asymptotics: The class coefficient inherits K1571: g log(1/kappa_g)->1/(12pi), (6gc_C^2-h_g^prof)/kappa_g^2->pi/16, and h_g^prof=4sqrt(24c_Cg)-4/c_C-c_Omega/2+o(1) at strong coupling.
coefficient_theorem.rigidity: At finite cutoff, equality requires equality in both K1533 and the defect inequality: up to constant phase the density is the unique K1572 Gaussian minimizer and the integrated defect vanishes. Non-Gaussian members can approach only by closing both nonnegative gaps.
coefficient_theorem.advance: This is a matching leading coefficient over a genuinely non-Gaussian density class, stronger than a Gaussian upper trial but still not the unrestricted ground-energy coefficient.
coefficient_theorem.scope_guard: No bounded-error recentering, unrestricted ratio convergence, localization, compactness, Mosco recovery, continuum interacting BRST operator or source-owned Hamiltonian follows.
